# technitium_settings_sso (Resource)

Manages single sign-on with OpenID Connect: the provider, sign-up rules and how the provider's groups map to local groups. The server restarts its web service when a change needs it. Destroying the resource leaves the configuration as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "sso_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

data "technitium_group" "dns_administrators" {
  name = "DNS Administrators"
}

resource "technitium_settings_sso" "this" {
  enabled                            = true
  authority                          = "https://auth.example.com/realms/home"
  client_id                          = "technitium"
  client_secret                      = var.sso_client_secret
  allow_signup                       = true
  allow_signup_only_for_mapped_users = true

  group_map = [
    { remote_group = "dns-admins", local_group = data.technitium_group.dns_administrators.name },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_signup` (Boolean) Create an account for a new user the first time they sign in with single sign-on.
- `allow_signup_only_for_mapped_users` (Boolean) Let a new user sign up only when they are in at least one provider group in `group_map`.
- `authority` (String) The OpenID Connect authority URL of the provider.
- `client_id` (String) The OpenID Connect client ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The OpenID Connect client secret. The server never returns it, so a secret changed outside Terraform is not detected.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Allow signing in with single sign-on.
- `group_map` (Attributes Set) Maps the provider's groups to local groups. An SSO user's local groups are synced from it each time they sign in. An empty set removes the map. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_map))
- `metadata_address` (String) The OpenID Connect discovery URL, when the provider does not use the default one.
- `scopes` (List of String) The OpenID Connect scopes to request. Technitium's default is `openid`, `profile` and `email`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--group_map"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_map`

Required:

- `local_group` (String) The local group its members join.
- `remote_group` (String) The group at the SSO provider.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_settings_sso.this settings_sso
```
